landing.heroText: A free digital business card. Show your QR — guests open your card without an app and leave their details. Note where you met and get reminded when to follow up.
landing.f1d: 10 templates, 2 colors. Link, QR, .vcf, print PDF.
landing.f2d: Guests leave their name and phone without an app, straight into your contacts.
landing.f3d: Where, when and what you talked about — notes, tags, status.
landing.f4d: A 'contact today' list and a morning e-mail.
landing.s1: Sign up and create your card in 60 seconds
landing.s2: Show your QR or share your link
landing.s3: Follow up with people on time
landing.a1: No. Scanning the QR opens the card in the browser.
landing.q2: Does my card stop working when my plan ends?
landing.a2: No. The public card, QR and .vcf keep working. Only editing and CRM are locked.
landing.a3: On the web with QPay (your bank app).
landing.a4: We never store visitors' IP addresses. Only you see your contacts.
landing.badge: With AI assist · Made for Mongolia
landing.f5d: Contacts from a card photo, note summaries, follow-up drafts and bios.
landing.f6d: Every e-mail shares your card — copy it in one click.
landing.annualNote: Pay yearly and save {{saving}}% — Pro is {{amount}} per year.
landing.f7d: Touch two phones and both cards land in both contact lists — no QR scanning needed.
landing.f8d: Turns like a real business card: your card on one side, QR on the other.
landing.f9d: No IP addresses stored, 2FA, every permission checked by the database. Passwords are hashed and data travels encrypted.
